verdict.rationale: Perplexity Computer is itself the AI agent users hand tasks to. The docs describe it taking on complex, multi-step work (web browsing, code in a sandboxed VM, email and calendar, 400+ connectors), with approval gates and clarifying questions, and returning structured results. A community report confirms it appears as a 'Computer' option in the perplexity.ai sidebar, making it a built-in assistant inside the product. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the in-app delegation UI (the docs focus on the MCP-server entry point), and independent hands-on reports of tasks being completed successfully.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
